load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained fairseq model ensemble and task from a checkpoint file path
translate_sentences: translate a list of sentences using beam search on a pretrained translation model
generate_token_hypotheses: generate token hypotheses from tokenized input sentences with configurable beam size
encode_decode_bpe: encode and decode sentences using a Byte-Pair Encoding BPE model interface
tokenize_detokenize_text: tokenize and detokenize text sentences using a tokenizer hub interface
